correction: The earlier list said "add the measurement to the relay allowlist / METAL_ALLOWED_MEASUREMENTS". That is NOT a requirement for direct control: it was stale legacy-recipe advice and is withdrawn.

whatItIs: relay/api-relay.js:143-149 - METAL_ALLOWED_MEASUREMENTS feeds the TUNNEL hub: permissionless attach of a box that dials the relay over the fleet tunnel (relay/api-relay.js:288-291, relay/tunnel.js:72)
relay/api-relay.js:2896-2907 - the relay's fresh-attestation answer for a TUNNEL box carries operatorAllowlist = that list
verifier/metal-box.mjs:60-62 - a client that did not pin measurements falls back to that relay list ("operator allowlist")
whyDirectControlDoesNotUseIt: metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:528-529 - planDirectBoot refuses relayUrl, relayHost, tunnelToken, fleetSecret, certsApi and ACME inputs: a direct guest never attaches to a relay tunnel

metal/enclave-metal.mjs:176-191 - the launcher refuses relayUrl, tunnelToken, fleetSecret, certsApi, ACME, publicUrl and inline registryKey for control "direct"; only the control front port may be forwarded (:199-201)
metal/guest/gsup.mjs:443 (direct branch) starts the agent with METAL_RELAY_URL/METAL_RELAY_HOST/METAL_TUNNEL_TOKEN empty (no tunnel)

metal/measured-control-verify.mjs:66-133 - a direct guest is verified by the CALLER's own expectation (expect.measurements, config digest -> HOST_DATA, attested TLS key, AMD chain/TCB/CRL), not by any relay list; step 3 refuses a relay terminating TLS in the path
relayAllowlistFindings.transitionalOnly: METAL_ALLOWED_MEASUREMENTS stays relevant only to LEGACY tunnel boxes (e.g. metal0 on the KEPT/production images) and to clients that verify them without pinning. If the hosted Platform API (which is relay/api-relay.js) keeps serving legacy tunnel boxes, its platformApi.relayEnv may carry that list for THOSE images; the direct measurement does not belong there and nothing in direct control reads it.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Owner direct config, bound by HOST_DATA
refs: metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:536 (fw_cfg hostAdmission digest must equal the bound hostAdmissionSha256)
requiredForDirectControl.what: identity (operator, publicUrl, repo), contracts/rpcs/quorum, isolation endpoints, replicas, controlPort, hostAdmissionSha256 (binds the host wallet/admission policy), optional platformApi / mcp / platformPolicyCarriers / leaseGas / ownerNomination members. Any change = new HOST_DATA = relaunch.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Launch with the owner launcher in direct mode
requiredForDirectControl.what: host config control:"direct", direct:<config file>, isolation backend snp-guest-per-app (release off), mode snp, registryKeyFile 0600 when selling, hostfwd only the control port; the pinned OVMF; the vCPU count/CPU signature used for the measurement (this value is for 4 vCPUs, family 26 model 2 stepping 1 - recompute for any other)

requiredForDirectControl.item: Trust lists that actually verify a direct guest carry this measurement
refs: metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:328-329 (platformApi.measurements: 1-8 digests, identical in every member config)
scripts/platform-api-admin.mjs:100 (genesis/handoff admin checks the same list)
requiredForDirectControl.what: owners' and clients' own pinned expectations; the Platform API group's measurements[] (all members on the new bundle before any config carries platformPolicyCarriers); hosted-MCP client expectations. NOT the relay allowlist.
